notes: Pencil page 15. The leaf starts in mid-sentence; scan 015 is not among the supplied 24 pages. It describes base-change functors as equivalences, while retaining the bracket “[mais pas surjectifs]”; the marginal note explains that not every algebraic curve over k′ must be isomorphic over k′ to one coming from k. The negation and bien sûr are present. The author names the catégorie de Teichmüller-Galois and identifies connected-object isomorphism classes with anabelian types (g,nu). At the end he writes “compactifiés profinis”, qualified by “en car. 0 du moins”, and the abbreviation st.-ext. The invariance statement about fundamental groupoids is recorded with its supplied context only; no general positive-characteristic extension of it is asserted in these notes.

checks.statement: An equivalence of categories need not be literally surjective on objects.
checks.outcome: Checked by the inclusion of one object into a groupoid with two distinct but isomorphic objects: it is fully faithful and essentially surjective without hitting the second object. Thus the source’s bracket is not a logical contradiction.
